purpose: Specialist workspace visual explorations; no layout integration

assets.direction: Annotated folio with soft paper depth
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium standalone transparent illustration concept for EquipED, an institutional learning-module evaluation workbench. NOT a website screenshot, NOT an icon, NOT a logo.
Primary request: Concept 01 — a carefully art-directed academic review composition, called annotated folio. A handsome upright closed folio of loose academic pages is the main subject, viewed almost front-on at a very slight oblique angle. Two offset sheets behind give real, modest paper thickness. On the main page, a few deliberately composed short dark-blue typographic rules imply academic content WITHOUT legible words. One passage has a small translucent muted amber highlight. A fine royal-blue editorial annotation bracket extends into a separate small floating excerpt slip at the right. A second short reference slip sits partly behind the lower left edge; restrained linking lines make the composition about close reading and evidence. A slim royal-blue annotation pen lies diagonally near the lower edge as the only supporting object. One neatly connected amber folded page corner recalls the Folio identity without using or redrawing the EquipED logo.
Style: refined editorial vector-like illustration with crisp geometric silhouettes, precise slender strokes, broad calm paper faces, very subtle material shading and contact shadows only between overlapping objects. More accomplished and substantial than a UI icon, lighter and cleaner than a 3D clay render. Small nuanced folds, balanced optical spacing. Institutional, mature, calm and academic. Avoid toy-like rounded forms. No characters.
Composition: landscape approximately 3:2; one unified asymmetrical arrangement occupying about 75 percent of image, ample transparent clearance around every edge; entire illustration visible, no crop. Visually layered, readable at 400–500 px wide; keep details large enough to survive that display size. No enclosing card, no background rectangle, no huge field of empty margin.
Palette STRICT: royal blue #1b3b87 and deeper blue #142f70; warm-white paper #fbfcfc; cool blue-gray #cad6da and #91a5ad; ink #1b2b33; small restrained amber #d9ad1d. Paper shadows may use quiet blue-gray tints. Amber under 5 percent. No purple, teal, orange or colorful rainbow.
Background: true transparent alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no ground plane, no room or desk scenery.
Text: no readable text, no lettering, no numbers.
Avoid: open books, graduation caps, magnifying-glass stock icon, dashboard mockups, charts, score bars, approval seals, checkmark badges, sparkles, blobs, people, faces, realistic photographs, excessive grain, thick outlines, glossy gradients, fake transparent checkerboard, watermarks. This is a polished bitmap concept intended to inform an editable SVG later.

assets.direction: Outlined paper and evidence with a folded ribbon
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone transparent editorial illustration concept for EquipED, a calm academic module-review application.
Primary request: Concept 02 — an elegant paper-and-evidence arrangement, drawn as precise vector-style artwork. This is a sophisticated illustrated object composition, NOT a web interface, icon set, diagram with labels, or logo.
Scene: a substantial tall academic manuscript sheet tilted subtly counterclockwise, a narrow reference folio behind it to the left, and two detached annotation slips composed in front at the lower right. Each page has a few spare, carefully spaced royal-blue and slate rules suggesting printed academic content with no readable text. A slender open annotation bracket links one amber-highlighted passage on the main sheet to a small excerpt slip. One long blue folded ribbon-like paper edge runs diagonally behind the sheets and creates a strong elegant silhouette. A connected small amber corner fold is the only bright accent. The pages and excerpt slips overlap at different depths, with a convincing composed relationship and generous breathing room. No pen; express the act of review through annotations and paper structure alone.
Style/medium: genuinely flat editorial vector aesthetic, hard-edged solid color fills, slender consistent blue linework, crisp joins, restrained layered-paper depth. Simple two-tone edge shadows confined tightly to overlaps. NO photorealism, NO rendering, NO volumetric lighting, NO gradients, NO blur, NO ambient glow, NO drop-shadow haze, NO glossy stationery. Refined enough for an institutional publication, rich enough to read as a large bespoke illustration rather than an enlarged generic icon.
Composition: landscape 3:2, compact asymmetrical central cluster filling about 75 percent, all edges fully inside canvas with ample transparent padding. Thoughtfully balanced shapes at different scales, readable at 400px wide. No background scene or enclosing rounded card.
Colors restricted to #1b3b87 royal blue, #142f70 deep royal blue, #fbfcfc paper, #cad6da cool neutral, #91a5ad slate, #1b2b33 ink, #d9ad1d amber. Use blue-gray only as small shape accents; avoid washing the entire illustration in pale blue. Amber maximum 5 percent.
Background: true transparent alpha with completely clean cutout edges and clear empty pixels beyond the objects. Never paint a checkerboard, dark background, halo, or colored backdrop.
Text: no lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks.
Avoid: characters, faces, open books, graduation caps, magnifying glasses, robots, sparkles, blobs, flowers, unrelated office objects, charts, progress bars, checkmark badges, approval seals, realistic shadows. The result should be a high-quality flat raster concept suitable for later rebuilding as editable animated SVG.
